whenToUse: You stress a condition or limit in documentation or help that must not be missed.
You show a tip apart from the flow of the text.
You warn people before an action that's hard to undo.
whenNotToUse: You're reporting the result of something just done (use a toast or alert banner).
You'd stack several on one screen until everything looks emphasized.
The content works fine as body text.

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: A state or announcement for the whole page.

alternatives.name: Tooltip
alternatives.reason: A short explanation opened only when needed.

accessibility: Use an aside with role="note" to mark supporting content within the reading flow. It's not a live notification, so don't use a live region.
Always show a title such as Note, Tip, or Warning so the kind isn't conveyed by color alone.
The icon is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
Keep a contrast of at least 4.5:1 between background and text.
